candidate: A — TipTap Pages (official Pro) + community pagination fallback

officialTipTapPages.evidence: npm install @tiptap-pro/extension-pages --dry-run → npm error 404 'could not be found or you do not have permission to access it' (no Pro registry token configured). TipTap Pages is a paid Tiptap subscription feature distributed via private registry (registry.tiptap.dev).
officialTipTapPages.conclusion: Cannot be practically validated without purchasing a Tiptap plan. All Pages capability claims remain DOCUMENTATION ONLY.

peerDependencyConflict.conclusion: INCOMPATIBLE with the ERP's TipTap v3 stack — adopting it would require pinning the designer to TipTap v2 or forking the extension.

findings: A4 page nodes render at exact 794x1123 px (A4 @ 96dpi) with 25mm margins, header and footer regions — professional page canvas look. PROVEN (03-page1-a4-header-footer-scaled.png)

DEFECT: initial content load is NOT paginated — a single overflowing page renders until the first edit transaction triggers repagination (1 page → 5 pages after inserting one character). PROVEN (01 + 02 screenshots + DOM measurements)
DEFECT: no intra-paragraph splitting — a paragraph that does not fit moves entirely to the next page, leaving large blank gaps at page bottoms. PROVEN (04-arabic-ltr-defect-and-paragraph-gap.png)

DEFECT: dir=rtl attribute on pasted content is stripped by the StarterKit paragraph schema — Arabic paragraph rendered LTR ('computedDir':'ltr'). Same class of RTL gap as the production Template Studio. PROVEN (CDP measurement + screenshot 04)

Editor-to-PDF path: the extension paginates the EDITOR VIEW only; there is no coupled PDF export — final PDF still requires a separate renderer (e.g. Gotenberg), so preview/PDF divergence risk remains. INFERENCE from architecture, not disproven in spike

erpProductionEditor.note: The ERP's existing Template Studio TipTap v3 editor (no pagination, no A4 canvas) was audited hands-on in the prior audit phase (REPORT_DESIGNER_DEEP_UX_ARCHITECTURE_AND_OUTPUT_QUALITY_AUDIT.md) — those findings remain valid for Candidate A's 'current state' baseline.
